en.title: From a template to your own live product
en.intro: Create an independent codebase, build a business workflow, pass the checks, then publish a version. These are developer actions performed in your terminal and repository.
en.boundary: The board is a working demo. Planned / In progress / Completed only save card status; they do not generate code, run CI or deploy a website.
map: Validation, business rules and server-side permissions

steps.title: Create a real project
steps.body: Install Git and GitHub CLI, sign in, then use the template to create an independent repository and clone it. Replace YOUR_ACCOUNT and my-product with your own names. The board below creates records, not repositories.
steps.code:
gh auth login
gh repo create YOUR_ACCOUNT/my-product --template chenhynju/fullstack-toolkit --private --clone
cd my-product
node scripts/init-project.mjs my-product
steps.note: The initializer changes the root package name and README titles and creates .env if absent. Update the visible branding separately. Keep @repo/* names unless updating all workspace references.

steps.title: Run locally and develop one complete workflow
steps.body: Install Node 22.14+ and the pinned pnpm 11.7.0. Use a new branch and a private development environment. For a booking app, first finish selecting a slot → booking → viewing/cancelling it, including failure paths.
steps.code:
corepack enable
git switch -c feat/first-business-flow
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm db:migrate
pnpm dev
steps.note: Open http://localhost:3000; the API uses 3001. Check that ports are free. Reuse authentication, error handling and i18n, then add your own domain rules. Every product needs its own database and environment.

steps.title: Make quality a release gate
steps.body: Run these from the project root. Fix every failure before merging. Add tests for real business behavior: invalid input, permissions, isolation and a browser journey, beyond a successful build or HTTP 200.
steps.code:
pnpm format:check
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
pnpm size-check
pnpm e2e
steps.note: Use a disposable database for browser tests: they create accounts and data. An administrator journey needs explicitly configured test credentials. A skipped test is not a pass. GitHub required checks must be enabled separately.

steps.title: Push to GitHub and review a pull request
steps.body: Review your diff, commit a focused change and open a PR. Check Actions logs and test reports; require the quality-gate and e2e checks before merging into main.
steps.code:
git diff
git status
git add apps/web apps/api packages/db packages/types
git commit -m "feat(booking): add first booking workflow"
git push --set-upstream origin feat/first-business-flow
gh pr create --base main --fill
steps.note: Stage only reviewed paths; add reviewed configuration/docs changes when needed. Never commit .env, credentials, databases or uploads. Configure branch protection, GitHub Environments and deployment secrets for each new repository; template files do not configure those settings.

steps.title: Deploy an independent product
steps.body: After tests pass, package the source and upload it to the new product’s own server directory. Configure an unused domain, ports and a private runtime.env. The example below is a Linux server command run from that uploaded project root.
steps.code:
python scripts/package_release.py .local/my-product-v1.tgz

# On the server, from the uploaded project root:
docker compose --project-name my-product --env-file /opt/my-product/shared/runtime.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
steps.note: Set APP_ORIGIN=https://my-product.example.com, unused WEB_PORT/API_PORT and a unique RELEASE_TAG=my-product-v1 in the private server file. Compose creates a separate project volume. Point DNS to the host, configure a dedicated Caddy HTTPS site and verify /api/health, /api/ready and the actual business flow. Replace example.com with your own domain. Protect runtime.env with chmod 600 and keep it out of Git.

steps.title: Release updates and recover safely
steps.body: Release with a new immutable version tag. Before database migrations, create and verify a consistent backup. Keep the previous images and source, run public HTTPS acceptance and check other services after switching.
steps.note: Use the previous images only with a compatible schema; otherwise restore the matching backup. Never run docker compose down -v on a live product. scripts/release.sh and the existing Deploy workflow target this toolkit installation: adapt host paths, ports, image names and secrets before using them for another product. Vercel/GHCR flows remain separate work, not actions triggered by a board status.

zh-CN.title: 从工程模板，到你自己的线上项目
zh-CN.intro: 创建独立源码工程，开发业务流程，通过质量检查，再发布一个版本。这些操作在你的终端、代码仓库与服务器中完成。
zh-CN.boundary: 看板是功能示例。“计划中／进行中／已完成”只保存卡片状态，不会生成源码、运行 CI 或部署网站。
map: 输入校验、业务规则与服务端权限
数据模型与版本化迁移

steps.title: 真正创建一个新项目
steps.body: 安装 Git 与 GitHub CLI 并登录，再从模板创建独立仓库并下载到本机。将 YOUR_ACCOUNT 和 my-product 换成你的账号和项目名；下方看板创建的是记录，不是代码仓库。
steps.code:
gh auth login
gh repo create YOUR_ACCOUNT/my-product --template chenhynju/fullstack-toolkit --private --clone
cd my-product
node scripts/init-project.mjs my-product
steps.note: 初始化会修改根包名、README 标题，并在缺失时创建 .env。界面品牌需另外修改；保留 @repo/* 包名，除非同步更新所有工作区引用。

steps.title: 本机启动，先开发一条完整业务流程
steps.body: 准备 Node 22.14+ 与项目固定的 pnpm 11.7.0。在新分支和独立开发环境中工作。以预约系统为例，先打通“选时段 → 预约 → 查看与取消”，并处理失败情况。
steps.code:
corepack enable
git switch -c feat/first-business-flow
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm db:migrate
pnpm dev
steps.note: 打开 http://localhost:3000，API 使用 3001。先确认端口未占用。复用认证、错误处理和 i18n，再实现自己的业务规则；每个产品使用独立数据库和环境配置。

steps.title: 用质量门禁控制交付
steps.body: 在项目根目录执行以下命令，修复失败后再合并。新业务需覆盖非法输入、权限、数据隔离及真实浏览器流程，不能只证明构建成功或 HTTP 200。
steps.code:
pnpm format:check
pnpm lint
pnpm typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm build
pnpm size-check
pnpm e2e
steps.note: 浏览器测试会创建账号和数据，必须使用一次性测试库。管理员流程需显式配置测试凭据；跳过不算通过。还需在 GitHub 单独开启必需状态检查。

steps.title: 推送 GitHub，通过 PR 审查
steps.body: 检查差异，按小步提交并创建 PR。查看 Actions 日志与测试报告，在合并 main 前要求 quality-gate、e2e 检查通过。
steps.code:
git diff
git status
git add apps/web apps/api packages/db packages/types
git commit -m "feat(booking): add first booking workflow"
git push --set-upstream origin feat/first-business-flow
gh pr create --base main --fill
steps.note: 仅暂存已审查路径；有配置或文档修改时再添加对应文件。禁止提交 .env、凭据、数据库或上传文件。每个新仓库都要配置分支保护、GitHub Environments 与部署密钥；复制模板不会自动开启这些设置。

steps.title: 部署成一个独立的网站
steps.body: 测试通过后打包源码，上传到新产品专属服务器目录。配置未占用的域名、端口和私有 runtime.env。下面的 Docker 命令在 Linux 服务器上、已上传项目的根目录执行。
steps.code:
python scripts/package_release.py .local/my-product-v1.tgz

# On the server, from the uploaded project root:
docker compose --project-name my-product --env-file /opt/my-product/shared/runtime.env -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
steps.note: 在私有服务器配置中设置 APP_ORIGIN=https://my-product.example.com、未占用的 WEB_PORT/API_PORT，以及唯一的 RELEASE_TAG=my-product-v1。Compose 会创建独立项目数据卷。再配置指向主机的 DNS、独立 Caddy HTTPS 站点，验收 /api/health、/api/ready 与真实业务。example.com 需换成你的域名。 用 chmod 600 保护 runtime.env，且不要提交到 Git。

steps.title: 发布更新，并保留恢复能力
steps.body: 每次更新使用新的不可变版本标签。数据库迁移前制作并核验一致性备份，保留旧镜像与源码；切换后执行公网 HTTPS 业务验收，并检查其他服务。
steps.note: 仅在数据库结构兼容时回退旧镜像，否则恢复配套备份。禁止在生产项目执行 docker compose down -v。现有 scripts/release.sh 和 Deploy 工作流针对 toolkit 站点；用于新产品前必须适配路径、端口、镜像名与密钥。Vercel/GHCR 流程仍属独立工作，看板状态不会触发它们。
